desc: Field recording of a .30 caliber bullet being dropped. This sound was recorded at On Target in Kalamazoo, MI. **The hyper-resonant quality of this sample is the result of Freesound's playback. The sample itself is much cleaner. No credit is required to be given when using this sound. However, I'd be happy to know where these sounds are being used and what projects the community is working on!
